author: m511_legacy
read_scope: Full candidate Employee module and all five browser definitions expanded over both layouts; complete actual main preparation/advice/Page owner, seed and mock transport, exact authored HTML deltas and actual old controller callers. No authored Design prepare/preview fixture is self-reviewed.
accepted: One explicit completeEmployee factory checks native-only name/email/numeric salary/nested profile types and returns Employee without Record-to-T casts. Entered creation copies current committed source-only a/chosen and supplies a new business ID; captured New remains empty choice catalog/null and uses native salary0 capture.

The entered branch uses prepare only, stops on invalid values without validating/committing valid siblings into the old row, and inserts once at the first full-store RowId. Captured New stays end insertion. showRow and existing Rows tests retain sorting/index/deleted-anchor responsibilities.

Checkpoint stores the immutable complete value of a live selection. Restore calls Rows.restore once, unbinds only the current draft, then uses changed selection onSelect or the explicit unchanged-ID bind branch exactly once. Received/all-row Revert stays a separate original command; its previous selector and cancellation behavior remain.

Loaded delete sets preview ID before Rows.remove, so Grid null-selection notification does not bind the same detail away. The existing Form owner retains last committed values while discarding that row draft; original deletion payload remains server-owned. Ordinary inserted removal unbinds captured values and drops its checkpoint.

Native-disabled preview never adds inert; application Restore/Save/Close remain available and the entered-copy command reports read-only state instead of calling prepare. Existing save-time inert/busy/abort owner now includes only the two new controls.

Current public actions/advice/search/save/declaration preparation and per-page row registrations remain intact. Search/received reload retire application references; checkpoint cleanup is Page-owned. No second Rows/Form/renderer, generic factory/dispatch registry, public API or dependency is authored in this app patch.
Both HTML layouts add only two native type=button commands, named detail Form and salary default0, preserving existing selectors/labels/CSS/template structure and fixed-ID rules.

All ten proposed browser cases align real mock wire/session behavior: entered versus captured creation, invalid no-add/direct sibling preservation, complete selection restoration versus received revert, one-bind counts for same/changed selection, retained reset/deletion payload, independent declared sibling and Close cleanup. Native classes are not serialized in page.evaluate.
